intro.script: Hey team, I'm trying something new here, and I hope it lands well. I've been working with the team on some savvy, cost effective adjustments that bring efficiency to the structural design and impact the project budget in a meaningful way.

chapters.title: Structure and steel
bullets: Refinements with Greg and Matt at ISE aim to eliminate all structural steel.
Living room roof steel goes first: less shear, cleaner load path, real savings.
First look at a site built living room, priced alongside modular. (Christian, Keith)
Floating stair is back, with a glass corner at the landing. Fun one to walk through!
chapters.script: Hey everyone, I'm trying something new this week, so here's a quick walk through before Friday. First, structure. I've been working with Greg and Matt at ISE on some refinements, and the goal is to take essentially all of the steel out of the house. The living room roof goes first. Deeper wood joists do the work, which means less shear, a cleaner load path, and real savings. Christian and Keith are also taking a first look at building the living room on site, priced right alongside modular. And the fun one: the floating stair is back, now with a glass corner at the landing.

chapters.title: Client items
bullets: Loft railing: cable or bars, to match the stair. Your call.
Nichiha and AL-13: where each goes, samples through Christian.
Patio door: sticking with Fleetwood, the Marvin and Milgard options fell short.
chapters.script: Roland and Sally, a few calls for you two. The loft railing, cable or bars, and we'll match it to the stair. Nichiha and AL-13, and where each one goes. Christian has samples. And the patio door. We looked hard at Marvin and Milgard, but they fell short, so we're sticking with Fleetwood.

chapters.title: Pricing and interiors
bullets: Refined 7 ft Marvin Essential window schedule to Method for pricing. (André)
Radiant heating and cooling bid awaiting MEG revisions. (Christian)
Bath mirrors from the Matrix Deco line, marble slab next steps. (Maria, Christian)
chapters.script: On pricing, the refined window schedule, Marvin Essential at seven foot heights, is headed to Method. The radiant heating and cooling bid is waiting on MEG's revisions. And Maria is pulling bath mirrors from the Matrix Deco line, with next steps on the marble slab alongside Christian.

chapters.title: Permits and site
bullets: Grading permit pulled 9/23. Earthwork start pending the appraisal. (Christian)
Soil work wraps by 10/15, foundations pour in spring.
Placer and state round 1 responses mid October, civil touch ups due 10/7.
Fire plan review moves to Truckee Fire, submitting once design changes settle.
chapters.script: Permits and site. Christian pulled the grading permit on the twenty third, and earthwork starts once the appraisal lands. Soil work wraps by October fifteenth, and foundations pour in the spring. Round one responses to Placer and the state go in mid October, with civil touch ups due October seventh. And fire plan review now runs through Truckee Fire. We'll submit once the design changes settle.

chapters.title: Next meeting
bullets: Friday October 2nd, 11:30am, with Toby and Kayla back.
chapters.script: Next meeting is Friday, October second, at eleven thirty, with Toby and Kayla back. See you Friday, and thanks, everyone.
